o1.biggest_strength: Exceptional brand voice alignment and a dedicated, sensible firmness test that directly answers Rohit and Neha's worry without making medical claims.
o1.biggest_mistake: Using 'orders per session' as the primary metric across almost all tests, which requires 4-week runs when upstream metrics like add-to-cart would give faster reads on top-of-funnel changes.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: More nuanced metric selection showing awareness of why add-to-cart might fluctuate (e.g. users currently adding to cart just to check delivery date/EMI).

o2.biggest_strength: Brilliant conversion reasoning on metric selection—noting that showing delivery date and EMI on the page might actually depress add-to-cart while increasing orders because users stop adding to cart as a workaround.
o2.biggest_mistake: Diluting the firmness question (19% of pre-sale chats) into review filters instead of giving it a clear visual widget like a firmness scale.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: A dedicated firmness explainer widget rather than bundling it into review tab filters.

reason: Both understood the data and business perfectly, but Output 2 showed deeper experimentation craft by spotting that showing delivery and EMI on-page would distort add-to-cart rates, and structuring two concurrent testing lanes to save months of time.
